title: [SEC]: Ed25519 Replay Attack Defense with Monotonic Nonce & Timestamp Verification
summary: Implement cryptographic replay attack mitigation for webhook and API webhooks using nonces and strict time bounds.
background: Attackers intercepting valid signed HTTP requests can replay them against endpoints to trigger duplicate processing.
problemStatement: Without nonce tracking and timestamp drift limits, signed requests can be repeated indefinitely.
proposedSolution: Develop ReplayDefense in apps/api/src/modules/webhooks/replay-defense.ts storing consumed nonces in Redis with a 5-minute TTL and rejecting any payload with timestamp drift >30s.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates request timestamp falls within 30-second allowable drift window
Enforces one-time nonce consumption stored in Redis with auto-expiry
Rejects duplicate nonces with HTTP 401 Unauthorized and security audit log
testingRequirements: Unit test rejecting replayed nonce within TTL window
Unit test rejecting payloads with expired or future timestamps

title: [NOTIFICATIONS]: Webhook Egress Payload Batching & Dynamic Window Aggregation
summary: Aggregate high-frequency payment notifications occurring within a time window into batched array payloads.
background: High-volume wallets can receive dozens of transactions per second, overwhelming subscriber webhook endpoints.
problemStatement: Dispatching one HTTP request per transaction causes destination server rate-limiting and high egress overhead.
proposedSolution: Build a BatchDispatcher in apps/api/src/modules/alerts/batch-dispatcher.ts grouping notifications for the same webhook target into JSON array payloads when arriving within a configurable aggregation window (1-10s).

problemStatement: Protocol operators do not know when contracts are nearing instruction limits until transactions abruptly fail on-chain.
